bio: Agostino Antonio was baptized on 30 August 1748, son of Giuseppe Orlando and Domenica Berardelli ([R4-S1]). He married Maria Mollame, daughter of Domenico, on 6 May 1782 ([R4-S2]). His parents and his wife are new to the tree.
